Interest earned by opening the menu is lost if the server crashes before the next transaction or autosave, while `lastInterestAt` was advanced in memory only — so the same window is re-accrued after a restart and interest can be paid twice for the same period.

title: An uncapped daily limit renders as 1.797E308
fix: Special-case 0 as "unlimited" in computeMax and the messages.
observation: When a tier's `dailyDepositLimit` is 0 (uncapped) `remainingDailyDeposit` is reported as `BigDecimal.valueOf(Double.MAX_VALUE)`. `BankerMenuView.buildInfoLore` special-cases it, but `BankerAmountView.computeMax` feeds it into a `min()` chain and the anvil "capped at $…" message can render `1.7976931348623157E308`.

title: setUser on the bank economy handler has no effect
fix: Remove the misleading calls.
observation: `bank.getEconomy().setUser(user)` has no effect: `Bank`'s handler is constructed as `new EconomyHandler(Currency.ZERO, null, false)` (Bank.java:42) with `useUser` final and false. The call reads as if bank balances were Vault-backed; if `useUser` ever became true the bank balance would alias the player's cash balance.

title: UserRepository reaches the UserFactory through an unchecked cast
fix: Inject UserFactory via the repository constructor or registry.
observation: `((Gangland) getPlugin()).getContext().get(UserFactory.class)` is an unchecked cast plus a service-locator reach-around from inside a repository. Any test or embedding that instantiates `UserRepository` with a non-`Gangland` plugin gets a `ClassCastException` during `doLoadAll`.

title: /glw eco deposit, withdraw and set accept negative amounts
fix: Reject amount < 0 (and <= 0 for deposit/withdraw).
observation: `Currency.parse` accepts a leading `-` (Keystone Currency.java:48-55) and none of the four economy sub-commands rejects it. `/glw eco withdraw -500 Steve` *adds* 500 while the message says 500 was taken.

title: Economy confirmations go to the target, not the sender
fix: Send *_TARGET to the target and the base message to the sender.
observation: The confirmation always goes to the **target** (`target.getUser().sendMessage`), never to the sender. `Messages.*_TARGET` variants exist (Messages.java:55-58) but are never used.

title: Bounty payout and money pickups ignore Maximum_Balance
fix: Clamp through one shared deposit helper honouring User.Account.Maximum_Balance; use the right message.
observation: The bounty payout and every money-item pickup deposit into cash with no `User.Account.Maximum_Balance` clamp; `/glw eco deposit` is the only path that honours it. The bounty payout also announces itself with `Messages.BANK_MONEY_DEPOSIT_PLAYER`, a bank-deposit string.

title: recentDeaths and downedBroadcasted are never pruned
fix: Remove on quit and expire by timestamp. Same as WB-17.
observation: `recentDeaths` (`ConcurrentHashMap<UUID, Long>`) and `downedBroadcasted` are never pruned — one entry per unique player for the plugin's lifetime.

title: A malformed bank_tiers.yml yields zero tiers and unbounded deposits
fix: Fail the load (keep defaults) and treat a null tier as "reject deposits", not "no cap".
observation: When the parsed map is empty the loader logs a warning and **keeps the previous registry**. On first load that previous state is `Collections.emptyList()`, so a malformed `bank_tiers.yml` yields a silent zero-tier registry: `resolveTier` returns `null`, `tryDeposit`'s cap check is skipped entirely (line 144 is `tier != null`), and deposits become unbounded.

title: message_es.yml is missing the Banker and Bank keys
fix: Covered by CM-15.
observation: None of the `Commands.Banker.*`, `Errors.Banker.*` or `Commands.Bank.Reset_Cap.*` keys exist in the Spanish file (verified with `grep -c`, result 0) while they are all present in `message_en.yml`.

title: user_stat.yml is actually a gang roster
fix: Rename it or author the real user statistics screen.
observation: The file registered as `user_stat` (GameplayConfig.java:173) contains a gang-member roster (`Display_Name: "&6&lGang Members"`, `Item_Source: "gang_members"`), not user statistics — either misnamed or the intended screen was never written.

title: Placeholder tier fallback differs from the banker GUI
fix: Use Banker.Fallback_Tier_Id in GanglandPlaceholder.
observation: Placeholder tier resolution falls back to `tierRegistry.first()` and skips `Banker.Fallback_Tier_Id`. A bank whose `tier_id` points at a deleted tier shows the *first* tier on the phone and the *configured fallback* tier in the banker GUI.

title: Bank placeholders show stale counters
fix: Call a read-only maintain() before reading.
observation: Bank placeholders read `depositedToday` / `capResetAt` / interest without calling `maintain`, so the phone screen shows a stale deposit counter and a `next_reset` instant that may already be in the past until the player opens the banker GUI.

title: UserRepository decodes rows with positional hard casts
fix: Use Number casts like BankRepository and wrap the load in try/catch.
observation: The `user` row is decoded with hard-coded positional casts (`(double) userData[1]`, `(int) userData[2]`, …). Any column reorder in `UserTable`, or a backend returning `Long`/`BigDecimal` instead of `Integer`/`Double`, produces a `ClassCastException` inside the async task with no surrounding try/catch. `BankRepository` is defensive (`((Number) result[v]).doubleValue()`); `UserRepository` is not.

title: Money_Symbol "" throws and multi-character symbols are truncated
fix: Validate at load (default "$" when empty) and allow multi-character symbols.
observation: `moneySymbol = str(root, "Money_Symbol", "$").substring(0, 1)` throws `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException` when an admin sets `Money_Symbol: ""`, and silently truncates multi-character symbols such as `"USD"`.

title: Banker interaction has no permission or distance check
fix: Add a use permission and a distance check in BankerInteractListener.
observation: No permission check and no distance check on the NPC right-click; `BankerFlow.start` does not verify the player is near the NPC, so anything that can fire `NPCRightClickEvent` for a banker opens a full banking session.

title: resolveTarget returns null silently for uncached online players
fix: Send a "player not loaded" message.
observation: `resolveTarget` returns `userManager.getUser(target)` without reporting anything when the player is online but not cached, so every caller's `if (target == null) return;` makes the command silently do nothing.

title: Level.addLevels returns 1 and burns the XP for a cancelled level-up (US-08 residual): a caller that charges per returned level charges for a level that never happened
fix: W5-L (owns core Level.java): subtract the XP and increment the counter only after the event is not cancelled (create a fresh LevelUpEvent per level, as US-08 already directs); flip the two pinned LevelTest cases; then the gang upgrade withdraws its fee only when addLevels returns 1, and upgrade is refused at Gang_Level_Max. Fix together with US-08: US-08 covers the XP burn and the maxLevel clamp, this row adds the wrong returned count and the fee consequence for gang levels. [found by the Gangs+ parity pass 2026-09-30; fixed in lane W5-L of brainstorming/gang-turf-wave-2026-09-30/PLAN.md]
tests: core LevelTest cancelled-event case (addLevels_cancelledEvent_stillConsumesExperienceEveryIteration and addExperience_cancelledEvent_keepsDrainingUntilBelowRequirement pin today's behaviour: flip both); GangUpgradeCommandTest (cancelled event: level, XP and bank unchanged; max level refused)
observation: [found 2026-09-30, Gangs+ parity pass; code-checked against master] addLevels: L79 subtracts requiredExp before L81 fires the event, L83 advances levelValue only if not cancelled, and L86 increments counter unconditionally, so a cancelled level-up returns 1 with the XP already spent; the same holds for user and gang levels (Level is shared). handleLevelProgression L130 has the same order. LevelTest L161-176 pins this today (200 XP minus 3 x 50 = 50 with the level unmoved). Overlap: US-08 already records the XP burn (P1); this row is the residual return-value and caller-fee half. Read from code and the pinning test; not run.

title: Lose_Money false deposits the death amount into the player's wallet on every death
fix: Fixed on cnc-lose-them (593fca45, T2): false now means no charge and no payout. economy.md and the old comment documented the deposit as intended; the semantics changed deliberately.
observation: [found 2026-10-05 by the Cops N Crooks 0.15 wave on branch cnc-lose-them; confirmed present on master 16d1f064] The else branch calls economy.depositAmount(Currency.of(deduct)), minting money on every death for servers that set Lose_Money false.

title: A broken death Formula throws inside the death handler, and a NaN/invalid result reaches Currency.of
fix: Fixed on cnc-lose-them (593fca45, T2): safe MoneyFormula warns once and falls back to 15% of the wallet; the withdraw is clamped to the balance.
observation: [found 2026-10-05 by the Cops N Crooks 0.15 wave on branch cnc-lose-them; confirmed present on master 16d1f064] ScientificCalculator throws in its constructor for a malformed Death.Money.Formula, so the death handler aborts; an invalid number reaches Currency.of.

title: memberManager.getMember(uuid) is dereferenced without a null check in about 15 command sites
fix: Add a MemberManager.require(uuid) helper that sends Messages.NOT_IN_GANG and aborts; null-check every call site (GangInviteAcceptCommand:168 now lives in gangland-mail).
observation: `memberManager.getMember(uuid)` is dereferenced with no null check in ~15 places. A player whose `Member` is not cached (never persisted, cache cleared by a reload, joined before the plugin) NPEs mid-command
impact: NPE aborts a command after side effects have already run

title: Gang delete payout runs async while the sync path deletes the gang
fix: Do the payout synchronously (or finish the async work and delete in a sync callback); never call Bukkit/Vault off-thread.
observation: The offline-payout block runs on an async thread yet mutates `gang.getEconomy()`, calls `memberManager.assignRank` (→ `Bukkit.getOfflinePlayer` → Vault) and races the synchronous `gangManager.remove(gang)` / `gangRepository.delete(gang)` at :294-310
impact: Money loss or duplication, Bukkit API off the main thread, non-deterministic disband

title: /glw gang withdraw (and deposit, rename, desc, display, color, invite, ally) have no rank gate
fix: Require a rank permission node via Member.hasPermission for every mutating subcommand.
tests: FIXED 0.8.3 wave 3, commit 8a731fd5; GangPermissions gate on every mutating subcommand (impl + mail); GangPermissionsTest
observation: `/glw gang withdraw` has **no rank or permission check** — the lowest-ranked member can drain the entire gang vault. `deposit`, `rename`, `desc`, `display`, `color`, `invite` and every `ally` subcommand are likewise ungated
impact: Griefing / economy loss

title: Rank parent edits never reach RankManager.ranksParent, so they are lost on restart
fix: Update ranksParent (add/remove RankParent) alongside the tree mutation and persist it.
observation: Parent edits mutate only `Tree.Node`; `RankManager.ranksParent` (the collection the `rank_parent` data supplier serialises) is never updated, so the hierarchy edit is silently lost on restart
impact: Rank hierarchy resets; promote/demote paths change under the admin

title: gang_ally primary key on gang_id alone keeps one row per gang
fix: Make the key composite (gang_id, ally_id) in GangAllianceTable and migrate existing rows.
observation: `gang_ally` declares only `gang_id` as primary key while alliances are stored one row per direction. `AbstractRepository.saveAll` → `TableBackend.upsertAll` therefore keeps **one row per gang**, so a gang with 2+ allies loses all but the last on every save
impact: Alliances silently disappear across restarts

title: Ally abandon never deletes the row, so the alliance resurrects on restart
fix: Delete both direction rows in GangAllyAbandonCommand through GangAllianceRepository.
observation: Abandon removes the alliance from memory but never calls `GangAllianceRepository.delete`/`deleteAllForGang`; the upsert-only autosave cannot remove rows, so the alliance returns on the next `loadAll`
impact: Broken alliances resurrect after restart

title: Promotion in a branching hierarchy never sends the options
fix: Send the built ComponentBuilder (or auto-pick when there is one child).
observation: When the target rank node has more than one child, a `ComponentBuilder` of clickable options is constructed and never sent — the command produces no output and no state change
impact: Promotion is impossible in any branching hierarchy

title: /glw option gang rank assigns any rank, including owner, to anyone
fix: Enforce the tree hierarchy and force_rank permission, or restrict the command to admins.
tests: FIXED 0.8.3 wave 3, commit 8a731fd5; RankAssignmentPolicy hierarchy check + narrowed completer; RankAssignmentPolicyTest (red-first)
observation: `/glw option gang rank <player> <rank>` assigns **any** rank (including `owner`) to any gang member with only a "not my own rank" check — no tree-hierarchy check, no `force_rank` requirement, and tab-completion lists every rank
impact: Privilege escalation inside a gang for anyone holding `gangland.command.option`

title: Rank delete leaves stale sets that re-upsert the deleted rank
fix: Detach the node, prune ranksParent/ranksPermissions, delete the rows, re-rank members and guard head/tail.
observation: Deleting a rank does not guard the configured head/tail, does not detach the node from `rankTree`, does not prune `RankManager.ranksParent`/`ranksPermissions`, and does not re-rank members wearing it. The next autosave re-upserts the just-deleted `rank_parent`/`rank_permission` rows from those stale sets
impact: Deleted ranks resurrect; members hold dangling `rank_id`; deleting `tail` makes gangs undisbandable

title: Transfer confirm lock never times out
fix: Use a CountdownTimer with auto-unlock and clear pendingTargets on quit.
observation: `confirmTransfer.lock(sender)` is called with no timer and no auto-unlock; `pendingTargets` (keyed by `User<Player>`) is cleared only on confirm
impact: Stuck confirm state and unbounded map growth across sessions

title: Mail expiry sweep runs async (start(true)) and is never cancelled (now MailModuleConfig.java:89-90)
fix: Use start(false) and stop the timer in the module's onDisabled/onPreClear.
observation: The expiry sweep runs with `start(true)` (async) and calls `MailManager.finish` → `repository.delete`, racing main-thread accept/cancel on the same `MailItem`; the timer is never cancelled on disable or reload
impact: Double delete, accept-after-expire, timer leak across reloads

title: RankManager.clear leaves permissions, ranksParent and ranksPermissions populated
fix: Clear every collection and reset Permission.ID.
observation: `clear()` resets `Rank.ID` and clears `ranks` + `rankTree` but leaves `permissions`, `ranksParent` and `ranksPermissions` populated; `initialize()` then `addAll`s the DB contents on top. `Permission.ID` is never reset
impact: Stale permissions survive a reload; id-counter drift

title: A renamed head rank creates a detached root and orphans the hierarchy
fix: Fail loudly (log and keep the previous root) when Gang.Rank.Head matches no persisted rank.
observation: If `Gang.Rank.Head` no longer matches any persisted rank name, a brand-new detached `Rank` becomes the tree root — not in `ranks`, never persisted, orphaning the whole existing hierarchy
impact: Renaming the head rank in settings.yml silently destroys the hierarchy

title: Online-player streams NPE on uncached members in ally request/accept/abandon
fix: Filter with a null-safe helper (memberManager.findMember(uuid).map(...)). Files now in gangland-mail (request/accept) and impl (abandon).
observation: `Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers().stream().filter(p -> memberManager.getMember(p.getUniqueId()).getGangId() == …)` NPEs on any online player without a cached `Member`
impact: NPE aborts an alliance mid-mutation, leaving one side added and the other not

title: GangMembersDamageListener uses getGang without a null check
fix: Null-check and treat as no gang.
observation: `gangManager.getGang(...)` results are used without a null check inside a `LOWEST` damage handler
impact: A stale `gangId` throws on every hit, effectively breaking damage handling

title: alliance_stat.yml button runs a non-existent "ally info" argument
fix: Register a gang ally info sub-argument or remove the click (re-checked on 0.8.2: still missing).
observation: Entry click runs `/glw gang ally info %ally_id%`; `GangAllyCommand.initializeArguments()` registers only `request/abandon/accept/reject/pending`
impact: Dead button in the alliance GUI

title: gang_stat.yml has no Slots block
fix: Same as UI-22.
observation: The file contains only an `Information` block (`Display_Name`, `Size: 54`, `Type`, `Configuration`, `Permission`) — no `Slots`, no items (corrected during verification)
impact: Empty GUI

title: GangCommand.gangStat is dead code (~140 lines)
fix: Delete it or wire it to the stat button.
tests: FIXED 0.10.0 CUT, commit 5d6cbefc: gangStat()/itemToBalance() deleted, zero callers anywhere in the reactor, commands.json, /glw help output, or gang_info.yml (which serves /glw gang info through the YAML-driven dialect instead)
observation: `gangStat(...)` is a fully implemented private stat GUI with no call site
impact: ~140 lines of dead code that will drift from the YAML views

title: GangBountyEvent and GangLevelUpEvent are never constructed, so the features are inert
fix: Fire the events from the bounty/level flows or delete the listeners and events.
observation: Neither event is ever constructed; the two listeners (`listener/player/BountyIncreaseListener:43`, `listener/player/LevelUpListener:44`) can never fire
impact: Gang bounty and level-up features are inert

title: SQL NULL becomes the literal "null" string in GangRepository
fix: Map null columns to null or a fallback explicitly.
observation: `String.valueOf(result[…])` turns a SQL `NULL` into the literal `"null"` for `name`, `display_name`, `description` and `color`; `Gang.getDisplayNameString()` then renders `"null*"` instead of falling back to the name
impact: Cosmetic corruption that also poisons duplicate-name comparisons

title: New rank ids come from totalRanks()+1 and collide after a delete
fix: Use max(id)+1 or DB autoincrement.
observation: New rank ids come from `totalRanks() + 1`; after any deletion the next id collides with an existing rank and the upsert overwrites it
impact: Rank overwrite / data loss

title: RankParent.parentId actually stores the child id and child rows are never deleted
fix: Rename the fields and delete both sides in doDelete.
observation: The record field named `parentId` actually stores the **child** id (`RankParent(headId, tailId)`; children are read as `rp.parentId()`), and `doDelete` deletes only rows where the rank is the parent side
impact: Confusing contract; child-side rows are never cleaned up

title: Accepting an invite leaves the recipient's other invites PENDING forever
fix: Cancel the recipient's other pending invites on accept and give offline invites an expiry.
observation: Accepting an invite does not cancel the recipient's other pending invites; those rows stay `PENDING` against a player who now has a gang, and offline invites never expire (`expiresAt = 0`)
impact: Unbounded stale mail rows

title: There is no invite reject command and commands.json has gaps
fix: Add a gang reject argument to the mail contribution and the missing entries (re-checked on 0.8.2: still missing).
observation: There is **no invite deny/reject command** — the "deny" workflow does not exist. `commands.json` also lacks `gang_ally_accept`, `gang_ally_reject` and a rank-vaultgroup "show" entry
impact: Missing UX plus help-layer drift

title: /glw permissions help entries are listed twice
fix: Remove the duplicate addAll.
observation: `getHelpInfo().addAll(list)` is called twice with the same list
impact: Every `/glw permissions` help entry is listed twice

title: /glw rank info prints Permission.toString()
fix: Append permission.getPermission().
observation: `permBuilder.append(permissions.get(i))` appends `Permission.toString()` (`Permission{usedId=…, permission='…'}`) instead of the node string
impact: Unreadable `/glw rank info` output

title: Display_Name_Char "" throws at startup
fix: Validate and default to "*".
observation: `str(gang, "Display_Name_Char", "*").substring(0, 1)` throws `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException` when the key is set to `''`
impact: Config parse failure at startup

title: getRootRank NPEs when the tree has no root
fix: Null-guard and fall back to the tail rank with a log line.
observation: `getRootRank()` = `getRankTree().getRoot().getData()` with no null guard; used by `MemberManager.initializeMemberData:74` as the fallback rank
impact: NPE during member hydration when the tree has no root

title: No gang-name validation; duplicate detection is skipped when Name_Duplicates is true
fix: Validate length, charset and colour codes; always reject exact duplicates.
observation: No validation of gang-name length, whitespace, colour codes or emptiness; duplicate detection is `equalsIgnoreCase` only and is skipped entirely when `Name_Duplicates: true`, after which `/glw gang accept <name>` and ally tab-completion depend on `name:id` disambiguation
impact: Chat spoofing and unusable identifiers

title: deleteGangName.get(user).get() can NPE at timer expiry
fix: Null-check the entry in the confirm handler.
observation: `deleteGangName.get(user).get()` is dereferenced inside the confirm handler; the map is cleared by the 60 s timer's finish callback
impact: NPE when the confirm lands in the same tick the timer expires

title: One bad MailType/MailStatus row aborts the whole mail load (now gangland-mail MailRepository.java:40-41)
fix: Guard per row: skip and warn.
observation: `MailType.valueOf` / `MailStatus.valueOf` throw on an unrecognised row and `doLoadAll` has no per-row guard
impact: One bad row aborts the entire mail load

title: Positional hard casts in member hydration; a missing member row is skipped under autosave
fix: Insert the row immediately and use Number casts.
observation: `initializeMemberData` reads member rows positionally with hard casts (`(int)`, `(double)`, `(long)`) and, when `GangSettings.isAutoSave()` is true, **skips inserting a missing member row entirely**
impact: Fragile against schema drift; a fresh member may have no row until autosave

title: The no-arg Gang() constructor can collide on random ids
fix: Move the collision check into generateId.
observation: `generateId()` uses `new Random()` per call over `Integer.MAX_VALUE`; only `GangCreateCommand:110-112` rejection-samples against collisions — the no-arg `Gang()` constructor does not
impact: Duplicate gang ids from any future caller of `new Gang()`

title: Colour confirm handler assumes the user still has a gang
fix: Re-check hasGang() before getGang.
observation: The confirm handler resolves `gangManager.getGang(user.getGangId())` without re-checking `user.hasGang()`
impact: NPE if the player left or disbanded while the GUI was open

title: Gang.equals without hashCode
fix: Add hashCode on id.
observation: `equals` is overridden on `id` but `hashCode` is **not**, while `Gang` participates in hash structures indirectly (`nameCount.merge(g.getName(), …)`, `Set<GangAlliance>` whose record equality delegates to `Gang.equals`)
impact: Identity-vs-equality inconsistency in alliance dedup

title: Console-allowed option command casts to Player
fix: Same as CM-07.
observation: The command is registered as console-allowed (`user = false`) yet every handler starts with `(Player) sender`
impact: `ClassCastException` when run from console

title: Free-text permission nodes are persisted and online attachments are not refreshed
fix: Validate via permissionExists and refresh online members' attachments.
observation: The command never consults `RankManager.permissionExists`, so any free-text string becomes a persisted `Permission` row, and online players' Bukkit `PermissionAttachment` is not refreshed (only Vault is)
impact: Permission-table pollution; node has no effect until relog

title: Gang.State defaults to OPEN in the constructor, the table default and the parseState fallback; wiring gang join would make every stored gang a walk-in gang
fix: W2-P2: default INVITE in the Gang constructor, the GangTable default and parseState (null, unknown and CLOSE map to INVITE, never OPEN) with a load migration for stored rows, and only then wire gang join (accepted for OPEN only, sets the join date) and gang recruiting open|invite. Covering tests: stored OPEN/CLOSE/garbage rows load as INVITE; gang join refused on INVITE and accepted on OPEN; GangCommandsJsonParityTest stays green. [found by gang-turf planning wave 2026-09-30; fixed in lane W2-P2 of brainstorming/gang-turf-wave-2026-09-30/PLAN.md]
observation: [found 2026-09-30, gang-turf planning wave census + review] Gang.State (OPEN, INVITE, CLOSE) is persisted but the 2026-09-30 census found nothing that sets or reads it, so the OPEN default is inert today. Every new gang is constructed OPEN (Gang.java L78), the state column defaults to OPEN (GangTable L33) and parseState falls back to OPEN for null or unknown text (GangRepository L85-93), so the day gang join honours the state every stored gang, and every gang created afterwards, becomes joinable without its owner choosing it.

title: A gang member's own arrow or projectile never damages them (no bow-boost, no self-knockback) while a gangless player can
fix: W5-F: rewrite GangMembersDamageListener onto the new pure FriendlyFireRule (PLAN 15.5): the rule allows self damage by default (Friendly_Fire.Allow_Self_Damage), keeps the GR-15 null guard, and only cancels when attacker and victim are different players of the same gang or of consenting allies. [found by the Gangs+ parity pass 2026-09-30; fixed in lane W5-F of brainstorming/gang-turf-wave-2026-09-30/PLAN.md]
tests: GangMembersDamageListenerTest self-shot case (red first: cancelled today, allowed after); FriendlyFireRuleTest (self row)
observation: [found 2026-09-30, Gangs+ parity pass; code-checked against master] onGangMemberHitMembers resolves the damager (a Player or the Player shooter of a Projectile, L31-35) and the victim (L36) to User objects; when both have a gang it cancels if isAlly or getGangId() are equal (L48). A self-hit resolves both to the same user and the same gang id, so the event is cancelled: a gang member cannot bow-boost with their own arrow or take the knockback while a gangless player can. Read from code; not run on a server.

title: Gang.Enable: false no longer disables gangs: its only remaining reader is civilians' GangAllyWeaponImpactListener
fix: W5-K: GangWorldPolicy owns the global switch (Gang.Enable false = gangs off everywhere) and the GangCommand root gate; W5-F: the ally-impact listener reads the policy instead of Settings.isGangEnabled. Keep CM-03's SettingsLookupImpl mapping for any module that still uses condition = isGangEnabled. [found by the Gangs+ parity pass 2026-09-30; fixed in lane W5-K (GangWorldPolicy global switch) and W5-F (listener) of brainstorming/gang-turf-wave-2026-09-30/PLAN.md]
tests: GangWorldPolicyTest (Gang.Enable false vetoes every world); GangAllyWeaponImpactListenerTest with Gang.Enable false (protection silently dropped today)
location: gangland-civilians listener/gang/GangAllyWeaponImpactListener.java:42; gangland-gang command/sub/gang/GangCommand.java:27 (@CommandHandler, no condition); gangland-api file/configuration/Settings.java:561
observation: [found 2026-09-30, Gangs+ parity pass; code-checked against master] Settings L561 still reads Gang.Enable into gangEnabled, but after the gang-module extraction the gang module carries no condition = isGangEnabled: GangCommand is a bare @CommandHandler (L27) and GangMembersDamageListener a bare @ListenerHandler. The only main-code reader of Settings.isGangEnabled() left is GangAllyWeaponImpactListener L42 (civilians module), so Gang.Enable: false drops ally protection against Bartizan gun impacts while /glw gang and melee same-gang protection stay live. CM-03 fixed the condition lookup; the gang-module move dropped the conditions.

title: Same-gang protection ignores Flame/Fire Aspect fire, tamed wolves and primed TNT: only Player and Projectile attackers are resolved
fix: W5-F: resolve the attacker through the FriendlyFireRule in one place: Player, Projectile shooter, Tameable owner, TNTPrimed.getSource(), and handle EntityCombustByEntityEvent (cancel the ignition between same-gang or consenting-ally players) so the later FIRE_TICK damage, which has no damager, never starts. [found by the Gangs+ parity pass 2026-09-30; fixed in lane W5-F of brainstorming/gang-turf-wave-2026-09-30/PLAN.md]
tests: FriendlyFireRuleTest (wolf, TNT and combust rows); GangMembersDamageListenerTest combust case (red first)
observation: [found 2026-09-30, Gangs+ parity pass; code-checked against master] The listener handles EntityDamageByEntityEvent only and resolves the attacker to a Player either directly or as a Projectile's Player shooter (L31-35); every other damager returns at L34/L35. A tamed wolf, TNTPrimed.getSource(), and the ignition from a Flame arrow or Fire Aspect (EntityCombustByEntityEvent, followed by FIRE_TICK EntityDamageEvent with no damager) therefore bypass the same-gang and ally rule. The resolution gap is read from code; that CraftBukkit fires the combust event even when the arrow damage is cancelled is expected behaviour, not run on a server.

title: GangOptionContribution rank verbs cast (Player) sender under a console-allowed /glw option tree: ClassCastException from the console
fix: W5-A: replace the four (Player) sender casts with an instanceof Player check (console gets a Messages line or, for verbs that name a target, works on the named player); W5-A already owns the file and its GangStaffVerbsTest runs each verb from a console sender. [found by the Gangs+ parity pass 2026-09-30; fixed in lane W5-A of brainstorming/gang-turf-wave-2026-09-30/PLAN.md]
tests: GangStaffVerbsTest (each verb from a console sender, the rank verbs included)
observation: [found 2026-09-30, Gangs+ parity pass; code-checked against master] The option command is built super(gangland, "option", false), i.e. not player-only, so the console can reach the tree, and the four existing option gang rank verbs start with Player player = (Player) sender (L68, L80, L115, L183). A console sender throws ClassCastException. Read from code; not run.

title: Bounty set withdraws the raw value but clear refunds the level-scaled amount (2x profit)
fix: Store the amount actually paid in the ledger (or refund unscaled); one source of truth.
observation: `set` withdraws the raw `value` but stores `calculateLevelScaledBounty(value, targetLevel)` in the ledger; `clear` refunds the stored (scaled) figure. With the default `levelMultiplier = 2` and a level-5 target the refund is 2x the payment.
impact: Direct money duplication: set then immediately clear for free profit

title: Negative bounty amounts mint money for the sender
fix: Reject amount <= 0 in BountySetCommand and enforce a configured minimum.
tests: FIXED 0.8.3 61d45ddc (#13); ParsedAmount routing + Bounty.Minimum setting; SettingsTest bountyMinimum cases + ParsedAmountTest
observation: `Currency.parse` accepts negatives and there is no min/max. `senderBalance.compareTo(-100) < 0` is false, and `EconomyHandler.withdrawAmount` (`keystone-hooks/.../EconomyHandler.java:72-77`) does `setAmount(current.subtract(-100))`.
impact: Negative amount mints money for the sender and drives the target's bounty negative

title: hasBounty is true for negative totals
fix: hasBounty = amount.signum() > 0 and clamp amount >= 0 in setAmount.
observation: `hasBounty()` is `signum() != 0`, so a negative total is "has bounty" and the killer is paid a negative amount.
impact: Killer is charged for a kill; every `hasBounty` consumer misbehaves

title: The wanted decay timer never starts on join because setLevel is deferred to the main thread
fix: Run the isWanted check after the main-thread setLevel completes (callback) or read the loaded level directly.
observation: `setLevel` reschedules to the main thread when called off-thread (`Wanted.java:71-74`), so `userWanted.isWanted()` at l.160 still reads 0 on the async join path.
impact: The wanted decay timer never starts on player join; levels persist forever until a new kill

title: UserBountyEvent is dispatched async but isCancelled is read synchronously
fix: Call the event synchronously and branch on the result.
observation: The `UserBountyEvent` is dispatched inside `runTaskAsynchronously` but `isCancelled()` is read synchronously on the very next line.
impact: The cancel hook is never honoured; a race on the event's mutable state

title: Wanted and bounty executors run async and call events, Vault and messages
fix: Use start(false) for both timers.
observation: `timer.start(true)` runs `WantedExecutor.execute`/`BountyExecutor.execute` off the main thread, and those call `Bukkit.getPluginManager().callEvent`, `EconomyHandler.withdraw` (Vault) and `context.sendMessage`. Repo convention (`feedback_repeating_timer_async`) says async is only safe for flag flips.
impact: Vault/economy calls off-thread; async event dispatch to sync-only listeners

title: The kill-combo window is 20x the configured seconds and the reset mutates a HashMap async
fix: timeLeft = Reset_After seconds (not ticks) and run the timer sync.
observation: `initializeTimer` sets `timeLeft = 20 * Reset_After` but `CountdownTimer` decrements `timeLeft` once per 20-tick period, so the window is 20x the configured seconds (default 200 s instead of 10 s). The expiry callback then mutates the plain `HashMap activeTrackers` from an async thread.
impact: Combos last far longer than configured; `HashMap` corruption under concurrent access

title: activeTrackers is a HashMap mutated cross-thread, never cleared, holding Player references
fix: Use a ConcurrentHashMap keyed by UUID, remove on quit and call clearAll() from shutdown.
observation: `activeTrackers` is a plain `HashMap` mutated from `recordKill` (main) and `handleComboReset` (async), and each tracker holds a hard `Player` reference. Nothing clears it on quit; `clearAll()` has zero callers.
impact: Memory leak, stale `Player` objects across relog, unsynchronised map

title: Quitting while downed leaves the player in spectator with 0.5 HP on rejoin
fix: On quit restore gamemode, health and flight before cleanup, or persist the downed state and restore on join.
observation: `cleanup(uuid)` on quit removes the registry entry, the task and the saved gamemode but never restores gamemode, health, flight or teleports.
impact: Quitting while downed leaves the player permanently in spectator with 0.5 health on rejoin

title: Downed state is dropped on reload/shutdown
fix: Implement BeanLifecycle and revive/restore every downed player in onShutdown/onPreClear.
observation: No `BeanLifecycle`/shutdown hook: on `/reload` or server stop, `DownedPlayerRegistry`, `respawnTasks` and `savedGameModes` are dropped with players still downed.
impact: Stuck spectators after a reload; the static registry outlives the plugin instance

title: A single reused WantedEvent/BountyEvent instance stays cancelled forever
fix: Construct a new event per tick.
observation: A single `WantedEvent`/`BountyEvent` instance is constructed at timer creation and re-dispatched on every tick. `Cancellable` state is never reset.
impact: One cancel by any listener permanently freezes decay/growth for that player

title: userSetBounty is keyed by the live CommandSender and never persisted
fix: Key by UUID and persist the ledger (or drop the ledger feature).
observation: `userSetBounty` is keyed by the live `CommandSender`. CraftBukkit's `CraftEntity.equals/hashCode` are entity-id based, so a relogged player is a different key; the map also retains strong `Player` references forever and is never persisted.
impact: Placers cannot lift after relog or restart; unbounded leak of `Player` objects

title: bounty.setAmount bypasses the ledger
fix: Route auto-accrual through addBounty with a system sender, or track a separate systemAmount.
observation: `bounty.setAmount(...)` is called directly, bypassing `userSetBounty`. `Bounty.removeBounty` then subtracts a ledger figure from a total that grew independently.
impact: `amount` and the ledger diverge; clears can zero out auto-accrued bounty

title: Bounty.Kill.Each is dead when the repeating timer is enabled
fix: Apply Kill.Each on every kill, then start or refresh the timer.
observation: With `Bounty.Repeating_Timer.Enable: true` (the default), `handleBounty` starts a timer and returns without ever applying `Bounty.Kill.Each`.
impact: The documented per-kill bounty value is dead config on the default settings

title: An over-max bounty returns instead of clamping
fix: Clamp to Maximum.
observation: Over `Bounty.Kill.Maximum` the method returns instead of clamping to the cap.
impact: Bounty silently stops growing rather than sitting at the cap

title: The timer cap is checked before the multiply, so it overshoots once
fix: Clamp after the multiplication.
observation: The cap check uses `oldAmount` before the multiply, so the write at l.71 can land above `TimerMax`.
impact: Bounty overshoots the configured maximum by one multiplication

title: recentDeaths and downedBroadcasted are never pruned
fix: Same as US-33.
observation: `recentDeaths` and `downedBroadcasted` are never pruned. `downedBroadcasted` is only ever removed inside the dedup branch of `onPlayerDeath`, which the downed path (no real death) never reaches.
impact: Unbounded map growth keyed by UUID; `downedBroadcasted` is effectively write-only

title: userManager.getUser(null) is safe only by accident
fix: Null-check the Bukkit.getPlayer result.
observation: `Bukkit.getPlayer(deadPlayerId)` may return null; `userManager.getUser(null)` happens to be safe only because `UserManager.users` is a `HashMap` (`UserManager.java:36`).
impact: Fragile; becomes an NPE the moment the map becomes a `ConcurrentHashMap`

title: UserManager.users HashMap is read from async callbacks
fix: Use a ConcurrentHashMap or keep all reads on the main thread (follows from WB-06/07).
observation: `users` is a plain `HashMap` read from async timer callbacks (`onKillComboReset`, executor contexts) while `PlayerJoinEvent`/`PlayerQuitEvent` mutate it on the main thread.
impact: Unsynchronised map: possible infinite loop / lost reads

title: Sign- and command-granted wanted levels never decay
fix: Start the WantedExecutor timer from one shared helper used by every grant path.
observation: Neither starts a `WantedExecutor` timer.
impact: Wanted levels granted by signs or by `/glw wanted add` never decay

title: Unguarded Enum.valueOf on sign content
fix: try/catch and treat the sign as invalid. Same as LS-22.
observation: Unguarded `Enum.valueOf(sign.getContent().toUpperCase())`.
impact: A malformed or manually-edited sign throws `IllegalArgumentException` on every interaction

title: Paying off a bounty destroys the stakes without refund or notice
fix: Refund the placers (or document the sink) and notify them.
observation: Paying off a bounty destroys the money and clears the ledger; the placers are neither refunded nor told.
impact: Economy sink plus silent loss of player stakes

title: Clearing another player's wanted level uses the self permission
fix: Add gangland.command.wanted.clear.others.
observation: `/glw wanted clear <player>` uses the same `gangland.command.wanted.clear` node as clearing your own level (`OptionalArgument` carries no permission).
impact: No admin/player separation for clearing other players

title: Self-bounty is allowed and there is no cooldown
fix: Reject self-targeting and add a cooldown setting.
observation: No self-bounty check and no cooldown; `/glw bounty set <self> <amount>` is accepted, and an alt can claim it.
impact: Alt-account laundering / bounty farming

title: The target is notified before payment validation
fix: Move the message after the withdraw succeeds.
observation: `BOUNTY_SET` is sent to the target before the sender's payment is validated.
impact: Target is notified of a bounty that may never be applied

title: The event's amountApplied is unscaled
fix: Pass the scaled figure.
observation: The event's `amountApplied` is the unscaled `value` while the applied figure is scaled.
impact: `BOUNTY_INCREMENT` understates the real increase

title: A tracker is allocated per kill even when cached
fix: Use computeIfAbsent with a lambda.
observation: A `KillComboTracker` (and its `CountdownTimer`) is allocated on every kill even when one is cached, because `computeIfAbsent`'s value is precomputed.
impact: Wasted allocation per kill; no functional break

title: onComboIncrement is never assigned
fix: Wire it or delete it.
observation: `onComboIncrement` is declared but never assigned by `EntityDamageListener.setupKillComboCallbacks`.
impact: Dead extension point

title: KillComboEvent is never called
fix: Call it in KillCombo.recordKill or delete it.
observation: Extends Bukkit `Event` and declares a `HandlerList`, but is never passed to `callEvent`.
impact: Misleading API: external plugins cannot listen for combos

title: killHistory is unbounded
fix: Cap the history length.
observation: `killHistory` grows without bound for the life of a tracker, and with #8 trackers are immortal.
impact: Slow memory growth on high-kill servers

title: pointKillCount is never reduced, so wanted climbs faster than intended
fix: Reset pointKillCount after a trigger.
observation: `pointKillCount` is never reduced after a trigger, so every subsequent kill re-triggers `handleWanted` until the threshold index catches up.
impact: Wanted level can climb faster than the configured curve intends

title: isEntityDead is inverted in name
fix: Rename it (survives) or fix the negation.
observation: `isEntityDead` is true when the entity **survives** (the negation is inside the initialiser).
impact: Inverted name invites a future regression; behaviour is currently correct

title: Blood particles spawn before the lethality check
fix: Move the call after the check.
observation: `createBloodParticle` runs before the lethality check, so every hit spawns particles from a `HIGH`-priority handler.
impact: Particle spam / perf on rapid-fire weapons

title: Attribute.MAX_HEALTH vs the 1.16 floor
fix: Same as US-07.
observation: `Attribute.MAX_HEALTH` (the post-1.21 enum name) is used against a declared MC 1.16 floor. Same pattern appears in three `cops-n-crooks` NPC classes, so it looks like an accepted repo-wide choice.
impact: `NoSuchFieldError` on old servers if the 1.16 floor is real

title: Wanted.Enable is parsed but never read
fix: Enforce it in the grant paths or remove the key.
observation: `wantedEnabled` (`Wanted.Enable`) is parsed but has no reader anywhere in the repo.
impact: Documented toggle that does nothing

title: Hardcoded wanted and combo strings; dead message keys
fix: Route through Messages.
observation: `Wanted_Level.Wanted`, `Not_Wanted` and `Paid` have no Java references. Conversely `"&e&lKill combo reset!"`, `"&c&lWANTED LEVEL: ..."`, `"&3Death penalty: "` and `"&cYou do not have a pending respawn."` are hardcoded.

title: phone_bounty.yml is registered but nothing opens it
fix: Implement it or remove it (with UI-21).
observation: The GUI is registered as an expected file but no code opens it or handles its slots.

title: CustomPlayerDeathListener static instance survives reload
fix: Inject the bean into RespawnCommand instead of a static.
observation: `instance` is a mutable static set in the constructor; a reload that rebuilds the bean leaves the old instance's maps orphaned while `RespawnCommand` targets the new one.
impact: Stale-singleton behaviour across reloads

title: stopTimer runs twice on quit (async and sync)
fix: Keep only the sync call.
observation: `stopTimer()` runs both asynchronously (LOWEST) and synchronously (HIGHEST) on the same quit.
impact: Redundant; the async call can null out a timer created after the sync stop

title: Cops can target downed players
fix: Filter DownedPlayerRegistry in findBestTarget.
observation: `findBestTarget` filters `isDead()` but not `DownedPlayerRegistry`, unlike `CopManager` l.496/515/591.
impact: Cops can target a downed (spectator) player

title: handleCommandExecution's return value is misnamed
fix: Return separate flags.
observation: `handleCommandExecution` returns `true` when the balance is at or below the threshold, which also suppresses `handleMoney`. The name says "commands ran".
impact: Confusing control flow; a future edit is likely to invert the penalty

title: Downing is decided at HIGHEST and ignores later damage reductions
fix: Decide at MONITOR (read-only) or recompute the final damage.
observation: `player.getHealth() - event.getFinalDamage()` is evaluated at `HIGHEST`; any handler that later reduces the damage or cancels the event does not un-down the player.
impact: False downing when a lower-priority plugin absorbs the hit

title: The bounty claim has no gang-relation check: reachable between gangmates once friendly fire can be switched on (and a gangless alt can always claim)
fix: Deferred (W4-H's file, EntityDamageListener): once W5-F allows friendly fire, skip the claim when killer and victim share a gang or are consenting allies, or pay it out per the owner's call; decide with the WantedKillTracker exemption (TF-49). [found by the Gangs+ parity pass 2026-09-30; fixed in lane Deferred; W4-H owns EntityDamageListener of brainstorming/gang-turf-wave-2026-09-30/PLAN.md]
tests: Future EntityDamageListener bounty-claim test between gangmates (not yet named in the PLAN)
observation: [found 2026-09-30, Gangs+ parity pass; code-checked against master] handlePlayerKills pays the victim's bounty to the killer whenever bounty.hasBounty() (L126-129) with no gang, ally or alt check. Today a same-gang or ally kill is unreachable because GangMembersDamageListener cancels the damage; once W5-F makes friendly fire switchable, two gangmates can farm a bounty between themselves. Latent, so Medium: reachable today only via a gangless alt, which is by design. Read from code; not run.

title: The star-drop charge is withdrawn before the level change, so a cancelled WantedLevelChangeEvent still charged the player
fix: Fixed on cnc-lose-them (ac20dc80, T1): WantedStars.drop sets the level first and charges only when the change was not cancelled.
observation: [found 2026-10-05 by the Cops N Crooks 0.15 wave on branch cnc-lose-them; confirmed present on master 16d1f064] WantedExecutor withdraws Amount x Multiplier^level and then decrements the level, so a listener cancelling the change still cost the player the money. Money loss needs a third-party listener.

title: A self-kill (own projectile) claims the bounty posted on your own head and counts as a kill
fix: Fixed on cnc-lose-them (743d7415): handlePlayerKills returns first when killer == victim: no claim, no kill count, no crime.
observation: [found 2026-10-05 by the Cops N Crooks 0.15 wave on branch cnc-lose-them; confirmed present on master 16d1f064] handlePlayerKills has no killer==victim guard, so a player who dies to their own projectile collects the bounty on themselves from nothing (money creation on a rare path).

title: handleWanted adds auto-bounty notoriety, a bounty timer and a chat line even when no star was added (already at max wanted)
fix: Fixed on cnc-lose-them (743d7415): handleWanted returns when wantedStars.raise(..) == 0.
observation: [found 2026-10-05 by the Cops N Crooks 0.15 wave on branch cnc-lose-them; confirmed present on master 16d1f064] incrementLevel is capped but the bounty block below it is not, so every kill at the maximum keeps inflating the bounty and restarting its timer.

title: BountySetCommand withdraws the poster's money before UserBountyEvent, so a cancelled event loses the money
fix: Fixed on branch cnc-0.15-polish (e7ea9068 refunds the withdrawn amount when a listener cancels UserBountyEvent; 34b3bd7a also tells the poster with DEPOSIT_MONEY_PLAYER). Refund-on-cancel was chosen over firing the event first. Not merged into cnc-lose-them yet.
observation: [found 2026-10-05 by the Cops N Crooks 0.15 wave on branch cnc-lose-them; confirmed present on master 16d1f064] The sender's withdrawAmount(value) runs before callEvent(UserBountyEvent); when a listener cancels, addBounty is skipped and the money is neither booked nor refunded. Needs a third-party listener.

title: A token bounty (Bounty.Minimum ships at 0) from an accomplice makes the killer's kill crime-free (owner decision)
fix: Open, owner decision: ship a non-trivial Bounty.Minimum, or require escrow from others to reach a floor before the exemption applies. The crime-free exemption is new in 0.15 (T13); Bounty.Minimum 0 is on master.
location: gangland-impl listener/player/EntityDamageListener.java (byOthers.signum() > 0 on cnc-lose-them); gangland-impl settings.yml:254
observation: [found 2026-10-05 by the Cops N Crooks 0.15 wave on branch cnc-lose-them; confirmed present on master 16d1f064] Bounty.Minimum ships at 0, so a friend who is not an ally can post a token amount on the victim. On master that only buys a token bounty; on cnc-lose-them it makes the takedown crime-free. Listed so the owner decision is tracked.

title: /glw wanted add|remove|clear no-arg actions cast the sender to Player with no instanceof check: the console throws ClassCastException
fix: Open (not fixed by the wave): reply with a player-only message for a non-player sender.
observation: [found 2026-10-05 by the Cops N Crooks 0.15 wave on branch cnc-lose-them; confirmed present on master 16d1f064] `Player player = (Player) sender;` on the no-argument path (WantedClearCommand.java:40 on master). Noticed by the T6 reviewer.

title: A civilian kill raises wanted twice: once in handleMobKills and again in CivilianDeathRewardListener
fix: Fixed on cnc-lose-them (38d82ab4, T7): civilian kills commit one KILL_CIVILIAN crime through the heat ledger; the listener's own incrementLevel was removed.
observation: [found 2026-10-05 by the Cops N Crooks 0.15 wave on branch cnc-lose-them; confirmed present on master 16d1f064] Both paths call wanted.incrementLevel() for a non-combat civilian death.

title: EntityDamageListener.onKillComboReset sends a hard-coded English string instead of a Messages key
fix: Open: move the text to a Messages key.
observation: [found 2026-10-05 by the Cops N Crooks 0.15 wave on branch cnc-lose-them; confirmed present on master 16d1f064] user.sendMessage(message) with an inline string; i18n drift.

title: documentation/developer/cops-n-crooks.md Wanted section documents snake_case settings keys that never matched the real Capitalized_Underscore keys
fix: Open: rewrite the section against settings.yml.
observation: [found 2026-10-05 by the Cops N Crooks 0.15 wave on branch cnc-lose-them; confirmed present on master 16d1f064] Doc drift, found by the T16 docs lane.

title: The 0.15 self-defence fight map never forgot pairs that did not meet again and recorded hits from damagers that are not users
fix: Fixed on branch cnc-0.15-polish (ea072adb): only a hit between two users is recorded, pairs older than the 30 s fight window are pruned on every recorded hit, and a quitting player's pairs are dropped. Not merged into cnc-lose-them yet.
tests: EntityDamageListenerTest (the two trackedFights tests added in ea072adb)
observation: [found 2026-10-05 by the Cops N Crooks 0.15 polish review on branch cnc-lose-them; not on master: the self-defence fight map is new in 0.15] firstHit and lastExchange were only cleaned when the same pair met again more than 30 s later, so every other pair stayed until restart, and a damager with no User (a Citizens player NPC) was recorded too. Bounded memory growth on long uptimes.

title: With the 0.15 heat ledger on, killing a vanilla villager, wandering trader or killable shop NPC raises no wanted level
fix: Fixed on master (1dca7140, pushed): HeatWantedTracker takes a managedCivilian predicate (CivilianNpcRegistry.getNpc != null, wired in CopsNCrooksModuleConfig.installCoreSeams) and commits Kill_Civilian for any CIVILIAN-marked kill the registry does not own; managed civilians stay with CivilianDeathRewardListener, so nothing is counted twice and the hostile-in-combat exemption holds. Heat-off path unchanged. Live test server still runs the old cops-n-crooks jar until it is swapped.
tests: HeatWantedTrackerTest (heatOn_unmanagedCivilianKill_commitsKillCivilian red before the fix; heatOn_managedCivilianKill_commitsNothing, heatOn_unmarkedKill_commitsNothing)
observation: [found 2026-10-06, owner report while testing 0.15.0 on the live server; regression from the 0.15 PLAN.md ruling "the tracker ignores CIVILIAN marks"] GanglandMarkDefaults marks VILLAGER, WANDERING_TRADER and PLAYER CIVILIAN by type, so the core EntityDamageListener counts those kills and routes them to the tracker, which assumed every CIVILIAN mark was a gangland-civilians NPC. CivilianDeathListener returns early for anything outside its registry, so no Kill_Civilian was ever published. Before 0.15 these kills gave a star (or a combo step).

title: The 0.15 search-zone ring shows as a half circle, or not at all from the zone centre
fix: Fixed on master (0108a530, pushed): WantedHud sends each ring point with force through Player#spawnParticle(..., data, true), resolved by reflection because the 1.16.5 compile API lacks it (falls back to the unforced call where absent). Still a per-player packet, so only the chased player sees the ring.
tests: No unit test can reach the forced path (the test classpath is the 1.16.5 API, so the fallback runs); WantedHudTest zone-ring tests still pin the per-player send and the point count. Needs the in-game check.
observation: [found 2026-10-06, owner report while testing 0.15.0 on the live server] Normal particles are dropped by the client beyond 32 blocks of the camera. The ring radius is 40-180 blocks, so only the arc nearest the player rendered, and a player standing near the centre saw nothing. The owner also asked that only the chased player sees it, which the per-player send already did.

title: The 0.15 escape compass is invisible unless the player happens to hold a compass item
fix: Fixed on master (0108a530, pushed), owner chose the boss-bar arrow: while SEARCHING the bar title gains Hud.Bar.Way ("%arrow% %distance%m", in-code fallback for older wanted_messages.yml), an eight-way arrow relative to the player's facing towards StarCard.exitPoint and the blocks to it. The held-compass needle still works. Wanted.Hud.Compass.Enable switches both.
observation: [found 2026-10-06, owner report while testing 0.15.0 on the live server] The 0.15 compass only called Player#setCompassTarget, which moves the needle of a compass (or the phone) in the player's inventory; nothing told the player to hold one, so the owner could not find it.

title: detainment.jail_id is UNIQUE, so a second inmate per cell is never persisted
fix: Remove setUnique(true) on jail_id; uniqueness belongs to the player uuid.
observation: `detainment.jail_id` is declared UNIQUE, so a second player detained in the same cell writes a duplicate `jail_id`.
impact: The insert/upsert fails with a unique-constraint violation and the second inmate's row is never persisted — `Jail.Max_Capacity` above 1 is effectively unusable across restarts.

title: JailService.ID is restored by last-row assignment, so /glw jail create can move an existing jail
fix: Seed from max(id)+1 in JailRepository/JailService.
observation: `JailService.ID` is a mutable static restored by plain assignment per loaded row (last row wins, not `max`). `EntitySpawner.loadStoredSpawners` does track the max, so the two are inconsistent.
impact: If rows come back unordered, or a middle id was deleted, `/glw jail create` reuses an existing id and `JailRegistry.setJailLocation` silently *moves* that jail instead of creating a new one, relocating its inmates.

title: Cop tier Health is never applied
fix: Apply tier.health() in CopNpcFactory.createCop (MAX_HEALTH attribute plus heal).
observation: `Health` is parsed for every tier in `cops.yml` but never applied — a repo-wide grep finds no `.health()` call on the cop path (only `CivilianNpcFactory.applyHealthBonus` for civilians).
impact: Every cop tier spawns with the vanilla PLAYER 20 HP, so the documented 20→60 HP tier progression does nothing.

title: Quitting while handcuffed promotes to JAILED with no sentence, so the player is never released
fix: Route the quit promotion through JailIntakeService (occupancy, seizure, expiry, paperwork).
observation: The HANDCUFFED→JAILED promotion on quit writes only the registry state. It bypasses `JailIntakeService` entirely: no cell occupancy, no inventory seizure, no wanted clear, no paperwork item and **no `sentenceExpiresAt`**.
impact: On rejoin the player is JAILED with a null sentence expiry, so `SentenceService.tick` returns early and they are never auto-released; without the paperwork item they cannot open the bail/bribe GUI either. Only an admin `/glw jail release` frees them.

title: PURSUING/RETURNING ping-pong keeps cops alive forever
fix: Fixed (0.11.0, branch npc-squad-navigation, b75971d3 + a791d780, merged to master 481c5252, 2026-09-27, phase H11; reconciled from the live db 2026-10-27): a failed path never sends a cop back; rotation counts only stuck-and-unseen AI ticks; a rotated-out cop stays RETURNING; only a cop whose target was restrained re-engages on release; a new wanted start sends the group's returning cops back to pursuit. Sandbox unreachable pillar 3/3
observation: `PursuingBehavior` gives up (leash, max ticks, or hopeless navigation) while `targetPlayerId` is still set and the target is online and unrestrained; `ReturningBehavior.tick` sees exactly that condition and transitions straight back to `PURSUING`, whose `onEnter` resets `pursuitTicks` to 0.
impact: The pursuit leash and `Return.Max_Ticks` never retire a cop chasing a live, unrestrained, wanted player — a PURSUING↔RETURNING ping-pong that keeps the per-player cop cap permanently full and prevents despawn.

title: The seized inventory is deleted before restore succeeds, so a failure loses it permanently
fix: Deserialise first and remove the cache and DB row only after applyInventory returns true.
observation: The cache entry is removed and the DB row deleted **before** `applyInventory` deserialises; a `ClassNotFoundException` or version mismatch only logs an error and returns false.
impact: The player's entire seized inventory is permanently lost with no recovery path.

title: Removing a jail leaves inmates pointing at a deleted cell (FK)
fix: Release or relocate inmates and delete detainment and jail_exit rows before deleting the jail.
observation: Deleting a jail does not release its inmates, delete their `detainment` rows, or remove the matching `jail_exit` row, and `detainment.jail_id` carries an FK to `jail.id`.
impact: Inmates stay JAILED pointing at a nonexistent cell (`teleportToJail`, the respawn hook and `ReleasePipeline.teleportToExit` all silently no-op), and the FK can also reject the delete on MySQL.

title: Attack cooldowns are decremented per AI tick (10x slower) and Attack_Cooldown_Ticks is unread
fix: Decrement by the AI tick rate and read Attack_Cooldown_Ticks.
observation: Cooldowns are expressed in game ticks but decremented once per **AI** tick (default `AI_Tick_Rate: 10`). `Attack_Cooldown_Ticks` reaches the provider and is never read at all.
impact: The effective fire rate is roughly 10× slower than the numbers suggest, and the documented attack-cooldown knob is dead.

title: Yaw and atan2 frames differ, so spawn-behind picks the wrong hemisphere
fix: Use Location.getDirection() and a dot product.
observation: `Math.toRadians(playerLoc.getYaw())` is compared directly against `Math.atan2(dz, dx)`. Minecraft yaw is measured from +Z and increases clockwise, while `atan2(dz,dx)` is measured from +X and increases counter-clockwise — the frames differ by 90° and a sign.
impact: The "spawn behind the player" and "visible to other players" checks pick the wrong hemisphere, so phase-1 spawns appear in front of the player as often as behind.

title: currentCuffCooldown is keyed by Player and cleaned only on success
fix: Key by UUID and remove on quit or expiry.
observation: `private final Map<Player, Long> currentCuffCooldown = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();` is keyed by the `Player` object and cleaned only in `onPlayerSuccessfulCuffing`.
impact: Every failed cuff attempt leaks a strong reference to a `Player` (and its whole entity graph) for the plugin's lifetime.

title: A cancelled transit is not saved and can resurrect after a crash
fix: Save the detained record in cancelInternal.
observation: Clears `transitExpiresAt` in memory but never calls `detainmentRegistry.save(detained)`.
impact: If the server crashes before the next auto-save sweep, a cancelled transit can resurrect through `resumeOnJoin` on the player's next login.

title: An unknown detainment state shifts every following column by one
fix: Do not increment v twice in the catch (read the value once into a local).
observation: `String.valueOf(result[v++])` already increments `v`, and the `catch (IllegalArgumentException) { v++; }` increments it a second time.
impact: One unrecognised `state` string shifts every subsequent column read by one, so `transit_expires_at` is parsed as `sentence_expires_at` and so on.

title: Cop spawner yaw/pitch use (double) casts on Float columns
fix: Use ((Number) x).floatValue().
observation: Yaw and pitch are declared `Attribute<Float>` but read with a `(double)` cast on the raw JDBC object.
impact: On a backend whose driver returns `Float` for those columns (MySQL `FLOAT`), `doLoadAll` throws `ClassCastException` and every cop spawner fails to load.

title: PotionEffect.INFINITE_DURATION on the 1.16 floor
fix: Use a large finite duration or an XPotion helper.
observation: `INFINITE_DURATION` is a Bukkit 1.19.4+ constant compiled to `-1`, while the project's declared floor is MC 1.16.
impact: On 1.16–1.19.3 servers a `-1` duration is not treated as infinite, so the restraint effects can expire or behave unpredictably.

title: Cops leak after the wanted level ends and the player quits
fix: despawnAllForPlayer on quit and when wanted ends.
observation: When `wanted.getLevel() <= 0` the spawn task stops **without** despawning; the AI task only self-terminates when the group is empty *and* the player is not wanted. If the player then quits, `startAITask` stops on the offline check but nothing calls `despawnAllForPlayer`.
impact: The `groups` entry and its live Citizens NPCs leak until `shutdown()` — orphan cops with no AI ticking them.

title: cop.destroy() without the EntityMarkManager leaks marks
fix: Pass the mark manager (or destroy through CopManager).
observation: Called without the `EntityMarkManager`, so `removeEntityMark` never runs on cop death.
impact: `EntityMarkManager.entityMarks` grows unbounded across a session and the PDC mark is left on the corpse entity.

title: /glw cuff never schedules transit and /glw uncuff bypasses ReleasePipeline
fix: Cuff calls TransitService.schedule; uncuff calls ReleasePipeline.release.
observation: `/glw cuff` never calls `TransitService.schedule`; `/glw uncuff` calls `DetainmentService.release` directly instead of `ReleasePipeline`.
impact: An admin-cuffed player is stuck HANDCUFFED indefinitely (only break-free, `/glw uncuff` or a quit changes it), and `/glw uncuff` skips inventory restore, paperwork stripping, transit cancellation, kill-combo reset and the exit teleport — contradicting the `ReleasePipeline` javadoc that says all release paths must funnel through it.

title: A player can be JAILED with jailId null when all cells are full
fix: Refuse intake (stay HANDCUFFED) and notify, or wait-list.
observation: Returns `null` when no jail is registered or all are full, and `setState(JAILED)` still writes the row.
impact: A player can end up JAILED with `jailId == null`: never teleported, `ReleasePipeline.teleportToExit` no-ops, and (combined with #4) never auto-released.

title: detainPlayer is called twice per intake
fix: Remove the redundant call.
observation: `jailService.detainPlayer(jail.getId(), uuid)` is immediately followed by `detainmentService.jail(player, jailId)`, which calls `jailService.detainPlayer` again.
impact: A redundant second `releasePlayer`-across-all-cells plus a full jail-row save on every intake; functionally harmless but doubles the write cost.

title: The static GUI allowlist survives reload and missed close events
fix: Make DetainmentGuiAccess a bean with onPreClear and revoke on a timeout.
observation: A `private static final Set<UUID>` allowlist with no bean lifecycle. `authorize` is called by both views; `revoke` fires only on `InventoryCloseEvent` and `PlayerQuitEvent`.
impact: If a GUI open is cancelled by another plugin (so no close event fires), the player keeps a standing bypass and can open chests and other inventories while jailed. The static state also survives `/glw reload`.

title: Bribe GUI reachability vs the HIGHEST cancel (unverified)
fix: Verify on a live server; if blocked, exempt NPC targets in the restraint blanket.
observation: The restraint blanket cancels `PlayerInteractEntityEvent` for restrained players; whether Citizens still emits `NPCRightClickEvent` depends on Citizens' own handler priority relative to `HIGHEST`.
impact: The handcuff-bribe GUI may be unreachable in practice. Unverified — needs a live-server check.

title: Transit countdown and sentence-complete messages are never invoked
fix: Call the contract methods from TransitService.tick and SentenceService.
observation: Implemented and backed by `message_en.yml` keys but never invoked anywhere (verified by repo-wide grep).
impact: The transit countdown ("Jail transit — Ns remaining") and the sentence-complete title never reach the player, so the 20-second transit window has no UI feedback at all.

title: Max_Cuff_Attempts never escalates
fix: Count failures in CuffingBehavior and transition to COMBAT at N.
observation: The value is stored and forwarded into `DuringCuffingEvent` and `CuffedEvent`, but no code counts attempts or escalates after N failures despite the javadoc and the settings comment.
impact: The documented behaviour ("escalates to combat after N attempts") does not exist.

title: CuffLockRegistry.releaseByCop/forceRelease are never called, so stale locks block cuffing
fix: Call releaseByCop in AbstractNpc.destroy and forceRelease on release/quit.
observation: Neither is called anywhere, and the registry has no `BeanLifecycle` clear hook.
impact: Dead API. A stale lock — from a cop destroyed on a path that skips `onExit` — permanently blocks cuffing of that player until a restart.

title: CopConfig snapshot is dead and incomplete
fix: Delete CopConfig or make it the single source.
observation: `CopConfig.fromProvider` omits `maxSpawnYDiff`, `spawnerMaxYDiff`, `minRepathAfterLossTicks` and `guardRadius`, and the object is only used for a debug log line (`CopLoader.java:72`) — everything at runtime reads `CopConfigProvider`.
impact: A dead snapshot class that will drift further from the provider; a maintainer editing `CopConfig` will see no behaviour change at all.

title: The money icon variation never varies
fix: Implement the range match in pickVariation.
observation: The `if (cost within [min,max]) return defaultVariation;` branch and the fallback both return `defaultVariation`.
impact: The money-denomination matching promised by the javadoc and the settings comments never happens; every bail/bribe button shows the same icon.

title: WantedLevelChangeEvent fires before the level updates (works by accident)
fix: Update the level before firing; keep CopListener on WantedStartEvent.
observation: `WantedLevelChangeEvent` fires *before* `this.level` is updated, so `CopManager.onWantedStart` invoked from `onWantedLevelChange` bails at the `!wanted.isWanted()` guard and the real start comes from the later `WantedStartEvent`.
impact: Works today only by accident of ordering; any reordering inside `Wanted.setLevel` silently breaks cop spawning, and a maintainer reading `onWantedLevelChange` will believe it is the active path.

title: Raw Sound and Particle constants in the NPC delegates
fix: Use SoundEffect and XParticle.
observation: Raw `Sound.ENTITY_FIREWORK_ROCKET_BLAST`, `Sound.BLOCK_IRON_DOOR_OPEN/CLOSE`, `Sound.BLOCK_WOODEN_DOOR_OPEN/CLOSE` and `Particle.CRIT` are used directly.
impact: Violates the project's `SoundEffect`/XSeries conventions and is version-fragile across the supported 1.16→1.21 range.

title: faceTarget teleports the NPC on every attack
fix: Rotate via the navigator/look instead of teleport.
observation: Rotation is applied with `entity.teleport(rotatedLocation)` on every single attack.
impact: Teleporting a Citizens NPC every attack can cancel or disturb the navigator and is packet-heavy with many cops; a rotation-only approach would be cheaper.

title: "Serve Sentence" button and sentence opt-in are not implemented
fix: Remove the button or implement opt-in.
observation: The field is documented as "null … when the player has not opted into serving yet", but intake always writes an expiry and the GUI's "Serve Sentence" button only closes the inventory.
impact: The sentence always runs from intake, so the "opt in" concept is not implemented and the button is purely cosmetic.

title: BreakFree counters are never reset
fix: Reset on release and quit.
observation: Entries are removed only on success or an explicit `reset(uuid)`, and `reset` has no call site anywhere.
impact: A small unbounded `Map<UUID,Counter>` leak, and a rejoining player resumes their old tap count when they are still inside the reset window.

title: Respawn uses cell occupancy that is never restored (world spawn, double teleport)
fix: Rebuild occupancy from DetainedPlayer.jailId at startup and use jailId for respawn.
observation: The respawn location comes from `jailRegistry.getJailLocation(uuid)`, which searches cell occupant lists rather than `DetainedPlayer.jailId`. Occupancy is never restored from the database at startup and is skipped entirely by the quit-promotion path (#4).
impact: After a restart, or after a quit-promotion, a jailed player respawns at world spawn instead of the cell; `handleRespawn`'s follow-up teleport then uses `jailId` and yanks them, producing a visible double teleport.

title: copAttackers never expires
fix: Expire entries by timestamp.
observation: Entries are removed only on death, downed, quit and shutdown, so a player who hits a cop and simply walks away stays a permanent combat target.
impact: Cops re-engage indefinitely, and the set grows across a session for players who never die or leave.

title: EntityType.valueOf is rebuilt per call and throws on typos
fix: Parse once at load inside try/catch.
observation: `EntityType.valueOf(name.toUpperCase())` runs on every `getDefaultMarkForType` call with no try/catch, and the lists are rebuilt each time.
impact: A typo in `civilians.yml`'s default entity lists throws `IllegalArgumentException` inside a damage or portal listener; it is also an avoidable allocation on a hot path.

title: EntityMark.isCivilian includes POLICE
fix: Rename to isNpc or split the predicates.
observation: `isCivilian()` returns true for `POLICE` as well as `CIVILIAN`, and `countForWanted()` is identical to it.
impact: A misleading name that `NpcPortalListener` currently relies on to cover cops; any future "civilians only" caller will silently include police.

title: snapshot overwrites an existing seized inventory
fix: Refuse a second snapshot while one exists (merge or keep the first).
observation: Unconditionally overwrites any existing snapshot for that UUID.
impact: A second intake before a release — for example #4's quit-promotion followed by an admin `/glw jail throw` — discards the first, older inventory.

title: isValid mutates entity flags on every damage event
fix: Separate the pure isValid from ensureDamageable.
observation: `cop.isValid()` has a side effect (`ensureDamageable` writes `setProtected`/`setInvulnerable`) and is called for every cop in every group on every `EntityDamageByEntityEvent` and `WeaponRaytraceImpactEvent`.
impact: O(cops) entity-flag writes per damage event server-wide, and `isCopNpc` becomes a mutating query.

title: stopNavigation is a no-op during a ladder climb and destroy skips cleanup
fix: Cancel the climb in stopNavigation and in destroy.
observation: Returns early while `ladderClimbActive`, so a behaviour `onExit` that "stops navigation" is silently a no-op mid-climb; gravity is only restored in `resetNavigationTracking` and the climb-completion paths, not in `AbstractNpc.destroy`.
impact: State transitions taken during a ladder climb do not actually stop movement, and a cop destroyed mid-climb skips navigation cleanup.

title: CopDeathEvent is never fired
fix: Fire it from CopListener on cop death or delete it.
observation: Never constructed anywhere in either repo.
impact: Dead public API that advertises an extension point which never fires.

title: Bail/bribe double-click race
fix: Re-check the state inside tryCharge/release.
observation: Neither re-checks the detainment state between `tryCharge` and `release`. `PaperworkView` closes the inventory before calling, which mitigates but does not eliminate a double-click race.
impact: A rapid double click, or a second click delivered before the close is processed, can charge twice for one release.

title: cuff_help and uncuff_help entries are missing
fix: Add the entries.
observation: No `cuff_help` / `uncuff_help` entries, while `jail_help` and `cop_help` exist.
impact: Cosmetic inconsistency in the generated help pages.

title: Transit fire drops silently
fix: log.debug when the commit is skipped.
observation: `if (!detainmentService.isHandcuffed(player)) return;` silently drops the commit with no logging.
impact: A player released between scheduling and firing produces no diagnostic; combined with #17 (`/glw uncuff` leaves the task scheduled) this is the normal path, so a genuine bug here would be invisible.

title: A waypoint warm-up started before an arrest or jail teleport survives it and teleports the restrained player out when it ends
fix: W5-F: add ONE new cops listener, copsncrooks/listener/police/RestrainedTeleportListener, on the api TeleportEvent that cancels for detainmentService.isRestrained(player) (it covers every waypoint type, not only GANG, because the flaw is in WaypointTeleport); cops otherwise untouched. [found by the Gangs+ parity pass 2026-09-30; fixed in lane W5-F of brainstorming/gang-turf-wave-2026-09-30/PLAN.md]
tests: RestrainedTeleportListener test in cops-n-crooks (restrained cancelled; free player not; exact class name set by W5-F)
observation: [found 2026-09-30, Gangs+ parity pass; code-checked against master] DetainmentListener.onCommand (L270-278) blocks commands of a restrained player, but nothing stops a warm-up already running: WaypointTeleport cancels a warm-up only on PlayerMoveEvent (L84-107), and no cops class listens to the api TeleportEvent or PlayerTeleportEvent (grep: only gadget GrappleAbortListener does). A player who starts a waypoint warm-up and is cuffed, arrested or jail-teleported before it ends is teleported away when the timer fires. Read from code; not run.

title: Barter consumes rejected (value 0) stacks
fix: Collect only valued stacks (mirror SellView.onConfirm) and return the rest to the player.
observation: `collectOfferedItems` grabs **every** non-air stack in the drop zone and `onConfirm` then clears every drop-zone slot. Items the barter valuator rejected ("not accepted", value 0) are consumed with the accepted ones. `SellView.onConfirm` explicitly avoids this by collecting only valued stacks.
impact: Silent item destruction — a player who drops one wrong stack loses it on an otherwise successful barter

title: TraderRespawnService.cancelAll never cancels the scheduled BukkitTask
fix: Keep the BukkitTask handles and cancel them.
observation: `cancelAll()` (called from `onClear` during a managed reload) only clears the `pending` set; the `BukkitTask` scheduled by `schedule` is never cancelled and still fires `TraderManager.spawn(staleData)` after the reload.
impact: Duplicate/ghost trader NPCs after a reload that lands inside a respawn window; the callback also targets a `TraderManager` whose `byId` map was cleared

title: The delayed spawnAllFromRepository can run after a reload
fix: Store the task and cancel it in onPreClear.
observation: `onInitialize` schedules `spawnAllFromRepository` 40 ticks later. A reload (or shutdown) inside that window runs `onPreClear`→`despawnAll` first, then the pending task spawns every trader again into a map that may no longer be the live one.
impact: Orphaned Citizens NPCs that no listener can resolve (their `byId` entry is gone), plus duplicate visible traders

title: ESC on /glw shop edit rewrites the shop file and strips comments
fix: Fire ShopEditedEvent only when the definition changed (dirty flag).
observation: `ShopEditedEvent` fires on **every** flow end, and the writer nulls every root key before writing. Opening `/glw shop edit` and pressing ESC rewrites the file, stripping comments and any hand-written keys.
impact: Loss of admin annotations; churn in version control; also see #5

title: Save renumbers every buy entry Slot
fix: Preserve the authored slots, or drop the Slot field and stop validating it.
observation: `buildNewDefinition` renumbers every buy entry's slot to its list index, so the persisted `Slot` values are rewritten on every save. The player-facing `ShopView` ignores `Slot` entirely (lays out sequentially into `INTERIOR_SLOTS`).
impact: Hand-authored slot layouts are silently discarded; the `Slot` field is effectively dead but still written and validated

title: Slot is never validated against Size
fix: Validate slot < size.
observation: Entry slots are validated as `>= 0` but never against `Size` (or against 54). A hand-edited shop with `Slot: 60` loads fine.
impact: Currently harmless because `ShopView`/`ShopAdminView` ignore `Slot`, but any future slot-respecting renderer gets an `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException`

title: Purchase overflow is dropped on the ground and INVENTORY_FULL is never returned
fix: Check free space for the full amount before withdrawing and return INVENTORY_FULL.
observation: Money is withdrawn before delivery; delivery overflow is dropped on the ground with `dropItemNaturally`. `PurchaseOutcome.INVENTORY_FULL` is therefore never returned, `Messages.SHOP_PURCHASE_INVENTORY_FULL` is never sent, and `TraderBuyListener.java:97-99` handles the branch with an empty body.
impact: A player buying 999 copies with a full inventory scatters hundreds of ground items that can despawn or be stolen

title: WeakHashMap<Player, State> is defeated by strong viewer references
fix: Key by UUID and remove on quit.
observation: `Map<Player, SellState>` is a `WeakHashMap`, but `SellState`/`BarterState` hold a strong `final Player viewer` reference (and a `MultiPanelInventory` that also references the viewer).
